title: Halo Dental header
description: Edge-to-edge top bar: paired-capsule emblem and wordmark on the left, a centred 6-item navigation row on desktop, and a white contrast CTA plus 40×40 locale and accessibility squares on the right. Phones show a compact white CTA and a three-line disclosure menu button.
notes: overlay (true by default) positions the header over the dark hero box and applies .dark token colours
Mobile navigation uses a native <details> element so it works in static HTML without JavaScript
name: halodental-header

props.name: mark
props.description: brand mark configuration on the left

props.name: nav
props.description: centred navigation links on desktop, disclosure list on mobile

props.name: cta
props.type: { label: string; mobileLabel?: string | undefined; href: string; }
props.description: primary white contrast button on the right

props.name: locale
props.description: two-letter locale button shown on desktop (e.g. "Fr")

props.name: showAccessibility
props.description: show the 40×40 accessibility icon button on desktop

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: accessible label for the mobile menu button

props.name: overlay
props.description: lie transparently on top of the hero (default true)
